name: @pipeworx/mcp-homebrew-formulae

tools.name: analytics_install
tools.description: Install counts. Pass formula to scope, or omit for top list.

tools.name: recent_formulae
tools.description: DOES NOT WORK and cannot be made to: formulae.brew.sh/api/formula.json no longer carries a `date_added` field on any of its 8,600 formulae (verified 2026-09-16), so there is nothing left to sort or filter by and this tool can only return an empty list with `empty_reason: "upstream_field_removed"`. Homebrew publishes no dated feed. For install popularity use analytics_install; for a single formula use formula.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-homebrew-formulae forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the homebrew-formulae pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
